lines.zh: 我贴着林间的地面跳跑
lines.en: I hop-run low through the wood.
My wings stay half open for balance.
I go forward in hops.
My long tail balances me.
I land on a dead log.
I turn sideways through the gap.

lines.zh: 我张开翅膀滑了一小段
lines.en: I spread my wings and glide a little.
I move along the treeline.
I walk with claws in the bark.
I spring up to a low branch.
I glance back before moving on.
I dash a few paces on the ground.
My head keeps turning.
I slip past the bushes.
I hang on the branch, head turning.
My wings are folded tight.
I wait for insects to rise.
I hold still like a dead leaf.
I hear something inside the bark.
I blink every so often.
I like this height.
I tidy my wing membrane.
I watch shadows on the ground.
I have no need to move.
The wind rattles the leaves.

lines.zh: 你的个头比我大太多了
lines.en: You are far bigger than I am.
I have two kinds of teeth in this jaw.
Your hands smell of insects.
I edge back along the branch.
I spread my wings to measure.
Do not reach that hand over here.
I can fly; you cannot catch me.
Your shadow lands right on me.
You searched for me a while.
I want a look at your hands.
My wing bent wrong.
Two feathers came loose.
The blow turns my head aside.
I give a short cry.
I fold my wings in tight.
I hide behind the branch.
My wings can still beat.
This wound is no obstacle.
I have written that down.
Is that an insect?
I stare at it without blinking.
I lean forward.
That will not fill one bite of mine.
I do not eat hard things.
I have flown down a little.
Let me see if it moves.
I will take it and fly back up.
You hit my wing.
I am this small, and you still hit me.
You pressed my wing.
One beat of my wings and I am clear.
I land on your shoulder.
My tail brushes your face.
Do not crowd, the branch is narrow.
I hop aside.
I did not fall off.
I spread my wings for you.
I hop twice on the branch.
This wood can hold us both.
My tail is raised.
We share one branch.
You are a little smaller than me.
My call is thin and soft.
We hunt insects together.
I snatch it and fly up.
I hold it in my claws.
It is bigger than my whole body.
I take it to a branch to work on.
It went down.

lines.zh: 我咬一口看看能不能吃
lines.en: Let me bite it and see if it is edible.
Whoever dropped it, it is mine now.
Not worth the effort.
I shove it off the branch.
It is stuck in the bark.
You disturbed my branch.
I keep my eyes on you.
Two kinds of teeth, head fixed on you.
This is my wood.
I am small, but my teeth are sharp.
I have come down from the branch.
I saw this first.
I can take off any moment.
Reach out again.
I begin counting at three.
One step back is all I ask.
I circle over your head.
I land on the branch behind you.
I wait for you to turn.
My wings stay half spread.
Raise a hand and I fly.
I count your moves from the air.
I stay at the edge of your sight.
You will never catch me.
One more circle around you.
I know this wood.
My tail tip is twitching.
The longer you stand, the harder it is to leave.
This is your last chance.
I have crouched low.
I have launched.
I dart in and bite.
My teeth are small and sharp.
Your hand snapped back.
I bite and fly up.
I rake the back of your hand.
That last one was only a warning.
I land on a high branch.
You raised your hand again.
I will come down once more.
Do not touch my branch again.
My wings clap once.
You cannot hit back at this.

lines.zh: 我的两种牙，先咬住你的肩膀。
lines.en: My two kinds of teeth find your shoulder first.
I glide down from the tree.
A small shape settles on the branch.
I test the wind with my wings.
There is food enough in this wood.
I flew in from the treeline.
I land on a low branch.
I turn my head twice.
The light here is nicely broken.
First I groomed my wings.
I climb a few steps up the trunk.
I chose the branch facing the sun.
The wood goes quiet for a moment.
I shake out my wing membrane.
I will watch from here.
My claws have their grip.
I land above your head.
Fire singes my wing membrane.
I tumble down from the branch.
Water pins my wings.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我从枝上震下来
lines.en: The blast knocks me off the branch.
An arrow grazes my tail.
Magic numbs my wings.
There are no insects left in this wood.
Lightning splits the tree beneath me.
The branch beneath me is gone.
